decisions.reason: Replacing Stripe with Coinbase Commerce for the fiat on-ramp does not change Brevo as the transactional email provider.
The provider switch for the fiat on-ramp does not change SIWE or the wallet-authenticated minting and transfer paths.
Fiat and non-crypto users still require email magic-link access; changing the on-ramp provider does not alter that authentication behavior.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not alter the coded-referral commission amount or automatic distribution rule.
The provider replacement does not change ticket issuance for referral-code mints.
The provider replacement does not change ticket allocation for mints without referral codes.
The fiat on-ramp provider choice does not affect unauthenticated access to leaderboards or pool values.
Changing the off-chain fiat on-ramp provider does not change the Base network deployment requirement.
The fiat on-ramp provider switch does not alter Chainlink VRF winner selection.
The provider switch does not change the ticket counters or permanent badges represented in NFT metadata.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not affect secondary royalty enforcement, pool funding, or ticket creation rules.
